query:
SELECT f.path_relative,
                  f.size_bytes AS "size_bytes!: i64",
                  lr.path AS root_path
           FROM files f
           JOIN library_roots lr ON lr.id = f.library_root_id
           WHERE f.issue_id = ? AND f.is_present = 1
           ORDER BY (f.status = 'owned') DESC, f.id
           LIMIT 1
